text.en:
A member of the Columbian mercenaries recruited to Londinium by Manfred. She and her squad left his command owing to conflicting ideals, and when they were ambushed, we were there to rescue them.
Now employed by Rhodes Island, she provides on-field medical support to our combat squads.
text.zh:
萨卡兹雇佣兵中的一员，自哥伦比亚被曼弗雷德召集至伦蒂尼姆，后因理念不合而带小队脱离原本阵营，受袭途中被搭救。
现接受罗德岛雇佣，为作战小队提供战场医疗支援。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 10%
Crystal distribution clearly visible on the right arm and chest.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.26u/L
Operator Paprika has been infected with Oripathy for several years; her condition is currently stable.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】10%
右臂及前胸处可见明显源石结晶分布。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.26u/L
干员明椒患矿石病已有数年，目前病情稳定。

text.en:
Paprika, a Sarkaz mercenary who left her original post, is a straightforward, lively girl.
When we first made contact with her, we could also see the silhouettes of a few other Sarkaz related to us behind her. In other words, this girl and the Sarkaz mercenaries she brought with her were guided to us.
With her childish appearance, not many see her as a full-fledged mercenary. At most, she's like a girl scout. She's too young, too inexperienced, and doesn't think most things through. A kid like her should never have been fighting a war in Londinium—Most operators who've met her share this opinion.
And that is indeed the case.
While working with her mercenary team in Columbia, Paprika took on only minor duties such as serving as a bodyguard or slaying wild beasts. When her team leader, Grimm, heeded Theresis's call and told everyone they were heading to Londinium, she did not even understand what this new contract entailed.
Trusting in her captain, the Sarkaz girl ignorantly marched into Londinium and followed the orders of the higher-ups. This lasted until she was brought back to the barracks by Manfred and soon saw for herself what war was really like.
text.zh:
这个自原本阵营中脱离的萨卡兹雇佣兵是个性格直爽，说话做事明快利落的姑娘。
在干员明椒与罗德岛的接触背后，我们可以看到另外几位与我们有关联的萨卡兹人的身影，可以说，这个女孩和由她带领的其他几个萨卡兹雇佣兵，都是被人为引导至此的。
明椒这个脸盘上还带着几分稚气的萨卡兹女孩，在许多人看来还完全称不上是一个合格的雇佣兵，充其量只不过是童子军罢了。她年纪太轻，经验不足，对许多事都缺少思考，像她这样的孩子，本不该出现在伦蒂尼姆这样的战场之上——这是许多与其接触过的干员统一的意见。
事实确实如此。
明椒在哥伦比亚时，不过是跟着所属的雇佣兵小队当当护卫，杀杀野兽。当时的雇佣兵队长格林接受特雷西斯阵营的召集，宣布他们将前往伦蒂尼姆时，明椒甚至还不清楚这一次他们接下的委托究竟是要做什么。
出于对队长的信任，懵懂无知的萨卡兹女孩就这样走进伦蒂尼姆，浑噩地执行上层下达的命令，这种状况一直维持到她被曼弗雷德带回军营，并在接下来的一段时间内，亲眼目睹了什么是真正的战争为止。

text.en:
Paprika's parents died in an accident when she was still young. Thus, she was raised by her grandmother in a small town in Columbia.
The town was several hours away by car from the nearest nomadic city, and a large number of Pioneers and Infected gathered in the area. Although life was hardly luxurious, she nonetheless enjoyed a happy, stable childhood thanks to the hand-knitted items her grandmother sold for a living.
Like most Sarkaz, Paprika became infected with Oripathy at a young age. According to her, on her tenth birthday she woke up, rubbed her eyes, and stood in front of her chipped mirror to find a small rock having emerged from her chest.
She immediately understood that she was already Infected.
The Sarkaz girl's condition was fairly stable most of the time, and she's had no critical flare-ups. To the Sarkaz, Oripathy infection is almost a foregone conclusion, so becoming Infected is hardly a major disruption to their lives. When a company, facility, or city already rejects the Sarkaz, it doesn't matter to them whether the one they're refusing entry to is also infected or not.
After her infection was confirmed, Paprika's path to adulthood became more or less set in stone:
Her grades at school were only average, so she had no opportunity to continue her education. The school she was enrolled in encouraged her to drop out, and no other would accept her.
Unable to attend school anymore, she at first helped her grandmother with her knitting business. Then she followed the local Pioneers and started slaying wild beasts out in the barrenlands for money. In the process, she came into contact with a team of Sarkaz mercenaries, and after spending some time with them chose to join them as well.
After all, other than becoming a mercenary, what choice did a Sarkaz like her have?
text.zh:
明椒的父母都在明椒幼年时亡故，女孩从小跟着姥姥，在哥伦比亚一个小镇生活。
小镇距离最近的移动城市有数小时车程，众多拓荒者、感染者在此聚集，虽然生活并不富裕，但凭借姥姥贩卖手工编织物的所得，明椒的童年也勉强能够算得上是快乐平稳。
就像很多萨卡兹人一样，明椒患上矿石病的时间非常早。据其本人口述，在十岁生日的早上，当她一觉醒来，揉着眼睛站到缺了一角的镜子前时，她忽然发现自己的胸口冒出了一个小小的石头。
明椒立刻意识到，这代表她已经患上了矿石病。
萨卡兹女孩的病情大部分时间较为平稳，基本没有出现太过危急的情况，对于萨卡兹人来说，矿石病如影随形，得病并非一件会将他们的人生搅得天翻地覆的大事。当一家公司、一个设施、一座城市拒绝萨卡兹时，他们往往并不会逐一判断被拒之门外的萨卡兹是否真的是一位感染者。
在确认患上矿石病后，明椒的成长经历就变得十分顺理成章：
本就成绩平平的她没有机会再继续念书，在读的学校劝她主动退学，也没有另一所学校愿意接受她的入学申请。
没有学校可去的明椒先是帮着姥姥打理了一段时间手工编织物生意，随后跟着本地的拓荒者开始在荒野上猎杀一些野兽赚取外快。在此过程中，明椒接触到了一支萨卡兹雇佣兵小队，在一段时间的相处之后，她选择加入他们。
毕竟，如果不做雇佣兵，像她这样的一个萨卡兹又能做些什么呢？

text.en: [Purchase Order 004] Items: Yellow, green, purple, and white yarn. Give me one bundle each. And two blacks! Usage: Personal use! Remarks: If there are any discounts, buy more! [Purchase Order 005] Items: Red, black, and white yarn, two bundles each. A sack of decorative colored beads. Usage: Personal use! Remarks: The brand we went with last time didn't work all that well. Try to pick something higher quality and more durable! It doesn't matter if it's more expensive. Be especially on the lookout for something that holds up against explosions... By the way, does anyone know how often W and Ines come aboard? [Purchase Order 006][Cancelled] Items: Red, black, and white yarn, ten bundles each. Usage: Personal use!!! Remarks: No need to worry about how well it holds up against explosions anymore. It's meant for holding explosives, anyway. [Purchase Order 007] Items: Red, black, and white yarn, ten bundles each. Five sacks of decorative colored beads. Usage: Ask that damn W! She's the one who's getting any use out of this! She said this can be expensed... I can expense this, right?! Remarks: Give me the cheapest you can find!! [Logistics Department Log] That Sarkaz girl who loves knitting just stopped by. She snatched the purchase order she turned in earlier right back. This is the second time she cancelled a purchase order this afternoon, though. I guess that white-haired bomb freak Sarkaz merc probably pulled her leg and told her something like, 'Your stuff's not so bad. They're just perfect for sticking bombs in to fool people. Make me a couple more next time.' She didn't have to make them. What an honest girl. As for expensing this stuff? Forget it. She has a knack for this, though, so maybe she should look into selling her wares on the ship. She'd probably make her money back.
text.zh:

物品：
黄色、绿色、紫色，还有白色的毛线各要一捆。
黑色的要两捆！
用途：
个人用途！
备注：
如果店家有折扣的话，可以多买一点！

物品：
红色、黑色、白色的毛线各两捆。
装饰用彩珠一包。
用途：
个人用途！
备注：
上一次的牌子效果不是很好，这一次麻烦选品质好一点的，结实一点的毛线牌子！价格贵一点也没关系，最好能耐炸……
顺便问一下，有谁知道W还有伊内丝她们一般多久会来一次本舰呢？
【采购申请006】【已撤销】
物品：
红色、黑色、白色的毛线各十捆。
用途：
个人用途！！！
备注：
不用考虑耐不耐炸了，反正就是用来装炸弹的。
【采购申请007】
物品：
红色、黑色、白色的毛线各十捆。
装饰用彩珠五包。
用途：
问W那个混蛋去！是她要用！
她说可以报销的……真的可以报销对吧？！
备注：
买最便宜的！！

【后勤部记录】
刚刚那个喜欢编织的萨卡兹小姑娘冲过来，把她刚提交的采购申请单直接抢回去了。
这是她下午第二次来撤销申请了。我看那个白头发玩炸弹的萨卡兹雇佣兵说什么“你送的东西挺不错的，适合拿来装炸弹骗人，下回再多做几个呗”就是在逗她玩，倒也不必真的给她做，这姑娘有点实心眼啊。
报销是不用想了，不过我看她织的东西还挺不错的，或许她可以考虑一下做点成品，直接在舰内贩卖，应该还能赚回本钱。

text.en:
Paprika has clearly matured after the string of events she experienced.
Having come face-to-face with the cold, harsh truth, she's started to think about a lot of questions she had never considered, such as what meaning does the rebuilding of Kazdel hold for the Sarkaz, how do wars happen, and why do people choose to give their lives without a second thought?
Just like how until recently she was still completely ignorant of everything. Why did so many Sarkaz participate in the war when they didn't even have a reason to fight? Why did they have to choose to either kill or be killed on the battlefield?
Are death and parting really so common to mercenaries that there's nothing to be so sad about, like what Old Grimm told her?
Paprika still hasn't found concrete answers to many of her questions.
However, every time she stares down at the old cigarette box in her hands, she thinks back to that night in the Columbian wilderness, when the mercenary team had set up a tent and a campfire. Old Grimm sat next to the fire. The exposed areas of the old Sarkaz man's body were covered in scars, and every time his lips twitched, the look on his face would scare the pants off any normal folks in the vicinity. Nonetheless, he would always give the freshest roasted jerky to the team's youngest girl, and downplayed it like he wasn't taking care of the youngsters.
When he talked about the good life awaiting the Sarkaz just around the corner, even the scars on his old face stretched as he grinned.
Sadly, luck wasn't on Old Grimm's side. Soon enough, he gave his life in Victoria. When she was detained by Manfred, Paprika held onto the cigarette box she got from the old man and tried her hardest to imagine the good life that he looked forward to so much.
What would that life be like? Would they never catch Oripathy again? Or would they get to pay less money each year and not be rejected for 'insufficient qualifications' when applying for school or work, simply because they're Sarkaz?
'I used to think being a mercenary was great. We put our skills to use to make a living.'
That's what Operator Paprika told our other mercenary operators.
'But they said I wasn't a full-fledged mercenary. They told me I hadn't even killed.
'Then I finally figured it out and made sure of it.
'It doesn't matter what grand objectives Manfred and the men above him have, at the very least, following a bastard like him and becoming a 'full-fledged mercenary' who kills without blinking an eye is not the kind of life I want to live!'
text.zh:
在一连串的经历之后，这个他人眼中的孩子已经明显有所成长。
与直白且残酷的现实正面相撞的冲击，令明椒开始思考起许多从前并未考虑过的问题。比如重建卡兹戴尔对于萨卡兹来说，到底有着怎样的意义？比如战争为何发生，人们为何坦然送命？
就像是她之前浑浑噩噩时一样，为什么大多数参与战争的萨卡兹甚至都没有一个战斗的理由，为什么他们必须在战场上做那道要么杀死别人，要么被人杀死的选择题？
生离死别是否真如老格林告诉她的一样，对于雇佣兵来说，是如此常见而不值得悲伤落泪的一件事？
许多问题，明椒尚没能得出一个确定的答案。
只是每当她看到手里的旧烟盒，就总会想起还在哥伦比亚时的那个夜晚，雇佣兵小队在野外支起帐篷，架起篝火，老格林坐在火堆边，上年纪的萨卡兹人裸露在外的皮肤上满是伤疤，扯动嘴角时露出的表情会将一般人吓得腿软，但他却会把烤好的肉干丢给队里的小姑娘，轻描淡写得好像这并不是对年轻人的一种照顾。
在他说起萨卡兹将过上好日子时，就连那张老脸上的疤痕也为之舒展。
只是老格林运气不算好，很快就在维多利亚送了命。被曼弗雷德扣押后，明椒拿着老工人给她的烟盒，开始尝试去思考老格林想要的，是一种什么样的好日子。
他们萨卡兹的好日子，是什么样？他们能不得矿石病吗？还是能不必每年缴更多钱，不会因为是萨卡兹就在上学或招聘时因“不符合条件”而被拒绝？
“我原本觉得当雇佣兵挺好的，我们就靠本事，能赚到钱。”
干员明椒这么同我们的其他雇佣兵干员诉说。
“但他们说，我这样根本算不上是合格的萨卡兹雇佣兵。他们说：‘你甚至没杀过人’。
“所以后来我想通了，我确定了。
“不管曼弗雷德还有上面的大人物有什么远大目标，至少对于我来说，跟在曼弗雷德这种家伙的身后，当一个习惯杀人的‘合格萨卡兹雇佣兵’，这绝对不是我想要的那种好日子！”

text.en: [Mistakenly Recorded Communications Log] 'I take good care of her? Do I now? I just thought I'd give her a hand since she's new here, and so young.' 'Huh? What do you mean, I'm bigger than her?! Of course I'm bigger!' 'This has got nothing to do with whether she's a Sarkaz or not. And nothing to do with the wool knee pads she gave me last week, either! That shit's for old people, they clash with my style!' 'She's been knitting a lot of stuff for everyone, saying it's her way of thanking them for always taking care of her. Plenty of people got them. She even made those earmuffs the Doctor's been wearing lately.' 'Hibiscus told me she likes that little medical pouch she got, too. I mean, it is pretty practical. So how come I got stuck with the knee pads? They even have these goddamn pompoms hanging off of them... No, that's not the point!' 'For a girl that young to get herself caught up in what went down in Londinium... luck sure wasn't on her side. But she's still got all four limbs, still alive and kicking. She's even saving up some money to send home, so she's definitely not completely down on her luck.' 'The little trinkets she made for Beanstalk's metal crabs don't look half bad, either. Aren't they planning on putting out some kind of merch? I know the Doctor invested some money in that, too.' 'And what's wrong with that? She became a merc because she didn't know what else she could do. She's got no real reason, otherwise. So if she's found something she likes doing, what's wrong with a little career change?' 'There are still loads of others who were dragged into this mess just like her. We can give her a push in the back, but we can't give her an answer. It's her own mess, let her sort it out. Let her look, hear, and think on her own.' 'She can handle it.'
text.zh:
【误录的通讯记录】
“我很关照她吗？也没有吧？我就是看她年纪小，又是新来的，所以拉她一把。”
“啊？你什么意思，我比她大！我当然比她要大！”
“和是不是萨卡兹没关系，也和她上周送我的毛线护膝没关系！那副护膝完全是老年人才喜欢的款式，和我的衣服根本就不搭啊！”
“这段时间她织了不少东西送人，说是多谢大家照顾她还是什么的，挺多人都收到了，博士最近戴着的那个耳罩不就是她织的嘛。”
“芙蓉也和我说挺喜欢她收到的那个小医疗包，确实还蛮实用的啦。但是为什么到我这，就变成毛线护膝了？而且上面还挂了绒球……不对，重点不是这个！”
“像她那种小丫头片子，掺和到伦蒂尼姆这次的事情里来算她运气不好，不过看她人现在没缺胳膊少腿，还能活蹦乱跳，想东想西，能存下钱定期往家里寄，也不算很倒霉了。”
“我看她给豆苗的磐蟹织的小东西就还挺不错的，她们俩不还合计着要出周边商品什么的吗？博士好像还投资了来着。”
“有什么不好？她当雇佣兵，只是因为不知道还有什么其他路能走，又不是有什么其他正经理由，如果找到其他想做的事，直接转行又有什么不行的？”
“和她一样莫名其妙被卷进来的人还有很多，我们是能拉她一把，但没法帮她得出结论。要解决她自己的烦恼，只有她自己去看，去听，去想。”
“她自己能行的。”
